title: Indexes
summary: Indexes are sorted lookup structures (B-trees) that make WHERE/JOIN/ORDER BY fast — like a book index vs reading every page.
learningObjectives: Apply the concept in a small program
Predict program output by reading code

sections.content: Indexes are sorted lookup structures (B-trees) that make WHERE/JOIN/ORDER BY fast — like a book index vs reading every page.
CREATE INDEX speeds reads but slows writes (every insert updates indexes) and uses disk. Add indexes on columns you filter/join/sort by.
Key points: composite indexes follow leftmost-prefix rules, EXPLAIN shows if indexes are used, and over-indexing hurts write performance.
Try this variation — change a value, predict the output, then run it:
sections.codeExample:
CREATE INDEX idx_users_email ON users(email);
-- experiment: modify a value above and predict the new output
